StatDef.label: melee armor penetration multiplier
StatDef.description: A multiplier applied to the armor penetration of this weapon's melee attacks.

StatDef.label: damage to downed or fleeing enemies
StatDef.description: A multiplier on the damage this weapon deals to an enemy who is downed or running away.

StatDef.label: filth pickup
StatDef.description: How likely this person is to pick up dirt and filth on their feet when walking over it, compared to normal.

StatDef.label: chance of better quality
StatDef.description: The chance that something made here comes out one quality level higher than the crafter's skill gave it.

StatDef.label: chance of double products
StatDef.description: The chance that a bill finished here yields twice the usual amount. Only things that stack are doubled.

StatDef.label: chance to spare ingredients
StatDef.description: The chance that a bill finished here gives back half of each ingredient that stacks.

StatDef.label: light radius
StatDef.description: How far the light this gives off reaches, in tiles. It needs no power or fuel.

StatDef.label: room warming
StatDef.description: Heat this gives off into its room, until the room reaches the temperature its trait names. A torch gives about 3.5, a campfire about 21.

StatDef.label: room cooling
StatDef.description: Heat this draws out of its room, until the room is down to the temperature its trait names. On the same scale as a heat source: a torch gives about 3.5.

StatDef.label: rot rate of stored items
StatDef.description: How fast food and other things that rot spoil while stored here, compared to normal.

StatDef.label: counted in colony wealth
StatDef.description: How much of this item's value counts toward the colony's wealth, which sets how large raids are. Its market value for trade is unchanged.

StatDef.label: soil fertility
StatDef.description: Added to the fertility of the soil this holds, so plants grow faster in it.

StatDef.label: plant growth
StatDef.description: How fast plants grow in this, before light and temperature. Fertility is unchanged, so anything that can be sown here still can be.

StatDef.label: filth shed per day
StatDef.description: How much filth this leaves around it each day: around a building, or wherever its wearer or carrier goes.
